desc: She is a chibi cat girl with long blue-to-purple gradient hair, cat ears, a star hair clip, heterochromia eyes (left pink, right gold), navy top with big detached sleeves with white cuffs, white frilled skirt, white socks, navy shoes, and a fluffy purple cat tail.
arms: both hands, the white wrist cuffs and both big navy detached sleeves
head_extra: the cat ears, the hair buns and the star hair clip
nobody_keep: the long blue-to-purple back hair and the fluffy purple cat tail

poses.working: Change only her arms: both hands now held in front of her chest at the height of her stomach, fingers lightly curled downward as if typing on an invisible floating keyboard; the big sleeves hang naturally from her forearms. Do not draw any keyboard.
poses.reading: Change only her arms: she holds a glowing translucent holographic page (light cyan, with lines of text) with both hands in front of her chest, a little to her left side, and looks at it.
poses.thinking: Change only her arms: her right hand (on the left side of the image) is raised with the index finger touching her chin while thinking; her other arm rests across her waist; the big sleeves hang naturally.
poses.dragged: Change only her arms: both arms raised up and outward, hands open and flailing in panic as if she is being picked up; the big sleeves flutter.

props.thinking: the starry purple thought bubble with a question mark above her and the sparkles
props.reading: the star-shaped glasses, the glowing translucent holographic text page and the star magnifier
props.working: the glowing purple holographic keyboard in front of her and the floating code symbols and golden sparkles
